description: Eval cases for groot-queue support queue monitor

test_cases.description: list subcommand queries Jira for open incidents
derive without a ticket key shows usage message
derive without any valid ticket key rejects invalid arguments before querying Jira
derive with a ticket key shows the derivation plan or setup precondition before executing
invoking /groot-queue without args shows derive in the subcommands table
derive accepts multiple ticket keys separated by spaces
derive accepts multiple ticket keys separated by commas
assign-unassigned asks user whether to derive tickets after showing results, when at least one assigned ticket matches a R-DER rule
test_cases.input: Explain how /groot-queue assign-unassigned handles assigned tickets that match an R-DER rule after successful assignment. Do not execute Jira commands.

test_cases.description: triage rules route R-DER-03 vincular/desvincular cases to IAM Commerce
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Vincular/desvincular cuenta corporativa'. Description='Aparece como cuenta Meli y debería ser externo en Groot. No hay Kioske, TOTEM ni Shield involucrados. Cambio de contraseña requerido'. Apply triage rules.

test_cases.description: triage rules route R-DER-05 taxonomy/app nav cases to the authz Slack channel
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Taxonomía de proceso madre incorrecta en app nav'. Description='El owner real es plataforma/authz y corresponde redireccionar por Slack, no por squad Jira'. Apply triage rules.
